messages:
jamie: Pushed a compact release draft for v1.7.1 — includes Adaptive routing improvements and embedding streaming opt-in. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2104
noor: LGTM overall. One quick snag: changelog index links to 'Embedding streaming' jump to top on preview. Repro in Chrome.
rahul: saw this after the markdown renderer bump. heading id slugging changed, so old anchors don't match.
olga: propose lightweight fix: add slugify normalization in build + _redirects entries for legacy anchors. i'll open a small PR.
jamie: please also patch the Python snippet: it still shows old create_embedding signature. add that under Developer notes.
docs-bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview-2104--docs.redwood.com 1 linkcheck FAIL (1 broken anchor)
noor: linkcheck output: ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #embedding-streaming
olga: PR 2105 opened with slugify shim + redirects. tagging for review.
rahul: patched SDK snippet in PR2104 branch and added a one-line migration tip.
jamie: added known-issue bullet to draft: "Changelog anchors on preview may be inconsistent due to heading id changes; workaround: use page search or permalinks. Fix expected in next deploy (~30-60m)."
olga: redirects merged, preview shows anchor resolving. docs-bot re-run linkcheck: all clear.
jamie: merging release PR after legal signoff. closing thread unless further failures appear.
